issues.detail: The Greek 'πρωι σημερον' (this morning) is translated as 'Buổi sáng, hôm nay' (Morning, today), which slightly shifts the temporal focus from a specific time of day to a general period. However, the major issue is 'χειμων πυρραζει' (winter burns/glows red). The Vietnamese 'sẽ có mùa đông' (will have winter) misses the descriptive verb 'πυρραζει' (burns/glows red), which describes the state of the winter/sky.

The Greek 'προσωπον του ουρανου' refers to the 'face of the heavens' (the appearance of the sky/stars). The Vietnamese translates this as 'mặt trời' (the sun), which is a significant factual change in meaning.
